description: "Show me certificate [crt.sh id]" / "get the PEM for cert [id]" / "which certificate has serial [hex]" — fetch one logged certificate from crt.sh by its crt.sh id or by its hex serial number. Returns the PEM body plus the logged metadata (issuer, common name, SANs, validity window). Use after crtsh_search_domain to pull the actual certificate for inspection, or to identify a certificate you only have a serial number for (e.g. from a CA revocation notice or a TLS error log).

id.description: crt.sh certificate id, as returned in the "id" field by crtsh_search_domain.

include_pem.description: Include the base64 PEM body. Default true.

serial.description: Certificate serial number in hex, e.g. "06b6e2677b20b8aa16af09f498667be23ead". Either id or serial is required.

name: crtsh_certificate
title: Crtsh Certificate
